Commentary.Commentary: The Indian bowlers like the English batsmen also showed a lot of patience and perseverance. On Day 1, they struggled to pick wickets in the first two sessions in spite of bowling great spells. But they didn't lose hope and bounced back in the evening session to run riot. Bumrah, Ishant and Jadeja shared the wickets among them while Shami was very unlucky not to get any. Now, the onus is on their batsmen to show some spine and take the game to the English team. Their innings starts in a while, hang around!

After winning the toss again, England got off to a decent start. Cook, playing in his last Test, added a maiden 50-run stand with Jennings, also the first for the home team in this series for the opening wicket. The latter fell but Moeen Ali held the fort after. He added another 50-plus stand with England's ex-skipper. Cook scored a brilliant 71 but couldn't carry on for long. After that, the Indian bowlers ran through the middle order. But once again, England's highest run-scorer of the series, Jos Buttler, refused to lay down the arsenal. He fought and stitched vital stands with the tail and as a result, England crawled their way from 181/7 to 322.

That's the end of the sheer will and grit from the English lower order. They hung around long enough to frustrate the Indian bowlers. Broad's perseverance finally ended as he went for the big hit against Jadeja and ended up breaking the 98-run stand. Buttler looked to up the ante and managed to connect few as well. He too fell to Jadeja in the end. Another class innings from him meant England hold the steering wheel and they can steer this Test now.

OUT! Taken, a four-fer for Jadeja! A beautiful innings from Buttler comes to an end. The change in field does wonders for RJ and India. Jadeja tosses this one on off and turns it away from Buttler. He goes after it from his crease and with hard hands. But the ball spins away to take the outside edge and flies towards Rahane standing as the lone slip. That's travelling and Ajinkya really showed good reflexes to grab it. Buttler misses out on a well-deserved century. Anyway, his knock has powered England to 332 and he is walking back amidst a huge roar from the crowd!
Outside off, left alone.
In line of the stumps, defended. Some change in the field as just two balls are left now.

Kohli misfields to allow Buttler a brace. Not something you'd see e'rryday. A tossed up ball outside off and Buttler drives it. The misfield in the inner ring from Kohli. Rahul runs from long off to cut out the batsmen for two.
Gets in line and defends the flatter ball on off.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side but misses.
Pushes this ball through covers and takes a run.

Nice. This is a good contest now. Seeing Buttler changing gears, Bumrah gets into the T20 mode as well. He bowls a slower ball outside off and entices Buttler into a shot. He does exactly that but is late on it. It goes uppishly but in the gap so no harm done.

SIX! Boom! Short ball but Buttler is unfazed by that. Bumrah looks to surprise the batsman with the bumper but Buttler hooks it from the top half of his blade. It sailed over the fence and into the crowd once again.
Short of a length ball around off, pushed to covers.

SIX! And T20 mode it is. What a swat that was! Buttler and his power. He gets a length ball on off and pulls the trigger from there. A swat across the line and it goes up and over the mid-wicket fence and into the crowd. 500 runs for Buttler in the season as well. Bang!
Hangs back and keeps it  out off the back foot.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A fierce square cut for no run. Buttler chops the shortish ball from the back foot and Dhawan in the deep, stops it from going past. Buttler denies the single as well.
Plants his front foot down the track to defend it nicely.
Jaddu-speed, which means a flat darter, on off, defended.
Buttler looks to go for the reverse sweep but fails to find the gap at point.
Shows the full face and keeps it out onto the pitch for no run.
A play and a miss. A length ball outside off, Anderson looks to poke at it but misses.
Hangs back to play out the full delivery.
Outside off, on a length, punched to mid off for another easy run.

Crisp! Buttler is oozing class right now. He flicks this fuller ball on his pads through mid-wicket. Dhawan runs from square leg and puts his foot between the ropes and the ball. Saves a couple there as confirmed by the third umpire who was referred.
Fullish around off, pushed to mid off for no run.
Drives the full ball down the ground and keeps the strike. End of a successful over for Jadeja.
Shortish in line of the stumps, pushed back.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Last man, James Anderson walks in.

OUT! What. A. Catch! Guess who's the Superman? The star in the slip cordon, KL Rahul. He has caught an exceptional one in the deep this time. Broad finally had enough of defending the balls out as he goes for a wild hoick over the long on fence. He lines up the quicker delivery on middle and off from Jadeja and lofts it over the infield. Rahul runs back from mid on and keeps his eyes on the ball. Just at the last moment, he dives in front to hold on to a stunning catch coming over his head. He stands up and signals to the dressing room stating the number of catches he has taken in this series and that is 13, the joint-most by an Indian fielder in a Test series. This also breaks the 96-run stand which came at almost 5 runs an over. Buttler to get into T20 mode now? Looks likely with the last man in.
On the pads, pushed to the on side for nothing.
Pushed through by Jaddu again on off. Jos goes back and punches it through the off side for a run.
Another length ball on off, Broad defends it down the ground for no run. He has looked solid in his approach. Have edged quite a lot but didn't throw away his wicket.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for another easy single.

Good stop! Saves a certain boundary there does the Indian skipper. Broad gets a thick outside edge to the fullish ball on off. Kohli at third slip gets his left hand out and manages to stop the ball going past him but can't save the single though.
Chops the back of a length ball to covers for no run.
Short of a length ball around off, Buttler punches it off the back foot through covers and takes a run. Bumrah has five balls to remove Broad.
Bumrah to share the attack.
Guides the shortish ball to square leg and keeps the strike for the next over.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
A flash and a miss. Jadeja turning it square at such pace, not easy to get under his deliveries. Jos looks to hoick it over covers from his crease but fails to connect with the ball.
Opens the bat face and gets it to third man for another easy brace.
Paddles this slower ball on off to the fine leg region for a single.
Starts with a faster one around off, Broad pushes it to the off side.
Jadeja to start after the break. He has a slip and a short leg.

We are back for the post lunch session. The Indian players make their way out to the middle along with the two umpires. The English pair of Buttler and Broad walk out and the latter will be on strike.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

More than 100 runs were scored in this session and England are not done yet. They still have two wickets to go and would now be eyeing to get somewhere close to the 350-run mark. The away side, on the other hand, has bowled well but just did not have luck on their side. They would hope the break changes their fortunes and they get rid of the remaining two wickets as quickly as possible. Join us for the second session in a while.

The Indians entered into Day 2 with a thought of restricting the English side to something under 250 but that was not meant to be. History repeated itself, as once again, the hosts' lower order has come to haunt them. It was Rashid and Buttler at the start who frustrated the visitors with a 33-run stand. Bumrah did get the breakthrough but the frustration did not end there. Broad then joined forces with Buttler and the two now are closing in on a 100-run stand.

What a session for the hosts! How many of you would have thought they would cross the 300-run mark at the start of the day? Well if you did so, you should surely buy yourself a lottery ticket because it has been a commendable effort by them. It is once again, that man, who has been exceptional for them down the order, Jos Buttler. He walks off to a standing ovation from the crowd and his teammates. He deserves every bit of it as he has not only bailed his team out of trouble but now has put them on the front foot.
Wide again but at the other side of the poles this time. Shami fires it down the leg side. Jos looks to flick it but misses the ball. Pant collects it with ease. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 2.
Buttler is well set and will not play at these wide ones outside off stump.
This time it's the number 10 batsman who opens his bat face at the last moment and steers this towards the third man area. One more run to be added in the home side's total.
A bit shorter of a good length, just outside off. Buttler stays back and taps it towards the point region to pick up a single.

Not the outside edge but it's the inside edge this time as Broad goes hard at it with a drive. Shami is lucky enough to find the edge this time but the ball deflects towards the square leg region for the English pair to exchange the strike one more time.

Starts a new over with a bit shorter of a good length on the middle stump line. The ball lands and seams in a bit. Buttler, looking to flick it, misses and gets rapped on the pads because of the inward movement on the ball. The ball is missing leg stump though. They take a quick leg bye too.
Wide of off stump, left alone.

And England's 300 comes up with this double. They were 181 for 7 at one stage yesterday but have done magnificently well to reach where they are now. Sharma on Broad's pads, Stuart gets across and tucks it into the leg side for a brace.
Shorter in length, blocked out off the back foot.
Sharma is the victim this time as he lands this one on a good length on off, angling across Broad. The left-hander tries to poke at it but the ball misses the bat.
A solid front foot defense this from Broad. That was like a proper batsman.
Fires it wide of off, angling across Stuart. He's very happy to shoulder arms.
This time it's good news for Shami. Buttler leaves this one instead of getting beaten and add to India's frustration.
And the never-ending story continues. A bowler lands this on a length around off, the batsman is beaten.

Edge found but single results. Shami continues with the tight line and length, Broad, looking to keep it out, pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball rolls towards the third man region for the second single of the over.
Bowls this one outside off, Broad leaves it alone.
Shorter in length around off, defended off the back foot.
Shami starts with a one on Buttler's pads. Jos flicks it through mid-wicket to get a single. Looks like the visitors are losing faith and it is evident that their intensity is dropping.
Keeps it outside off, Broad leaves.

FOUR! If you slash, slash hard! Broad does exactly that as he sees the width outside off, on this short of a length ball. Goes for the fierce slash, gets a top edge and the ball flies over the slip cordon for a boundary. The hosts motoring along.
A bit shorter on middle and off, Buttler goes back, taps it into the point region and runs through to add a run to his and England's total.
Fuller and attacking the stumps, Buttler lunges forward and blocks it out with a straight bat.
Strays on Broad's pads and he flicks it nonchalantly to the square leg region for one more.

Sharma angles this one into Buttler and lands it a bit shorter of a good length. Buttler fails to make contact and is rapped on the thigh pad. The ball deflects into the cover region and the batsmen take a single.
Fuller and straighter, defended off the front foot.

This is probably the one hundred and twenty first time the ball has beaten the bat off Shami's bowling. This time it's the southpaw who is beaten. Shami from around the wicket keeps it on a length around off and nips away just slightly. Broad goes for the drive and as has been the norm, gets beaten.
Fires it on his pads and gets flicked to the square leg region for a single.
Beaten...again! A typical Shami delivery. On a good length around off, moving away. Batsman gets sucked into the drive and gets beaten. This has become copy-paste stuff for me now.

And luck is still unhappy with Shami. This time he is lucky enough to find the outside edge but, more importantly, not a wicket. Lands it on a length around middle and gets it to deviate away on hitting the deck. Buttler, from his crease, tries to keep it out but gets an outside edge. The ball rolls towards the vacant gully region for yet another brace. Hard luck, Shami!
Well bowled. Keeps it on a good length fractionally outside off. The ball lands and moves away. Buttler watchfully lets it go.
A brace to end a good over for England! 8 from it. Outside off, Broad reaches out for it. Gets it through cover-point and runs two.
Shorter in length outside off, Buttler pushes it through covers and takes a run.
FOUR! Exceptional! Buttler at his best! A half-volley and Buttler says thank you so much. He leans into it and strokes it through covers for a boundary.
On a length and it comes back into the batsman. Buttler off the back foot keeps it out.
Full and on off, Buttler times it towards mid off but for no runs.
Nicely played again! Back of a length on off. Broad, with soft hands, guides it through backward point for a run.
Good line and length from Shami. Broad shows respect by confidently defending it.
Fuller around off, Buttler leans forward and drives it towards the cover region for a single. Buttler taking the game away from India here.
Wide of off again, Buttler shoulders arms. No need to take risks as runs are coming easily.

Fifty for Buttler, once again, it is that man who has bailed the England side out of trouble. How well has he fit into this Test side? It is his 10th in this format as he punches the ball through covers and takes a run to get to that milestone. He soaks in the applause by the crowd by raising his bat. Can he now get to his second ton of the series? He and England would surely love that.
Wide of off, left alone.

FOUR! Streaky! But as they say, luck favors the brave. Buttler has been brave and the visitors have been the opposite. Shami starts the over with a beautiful delivery. Keeps it on a good length around off. Buttler goes for the drive on the up with no foot movement. However, the ball moves away on landing and takes the outside edge. It flies towards the slip cordon. The Indians here are not brave enough as they have just two slips in. The ball flies through the vacant third slip region and England get four more.
Back of a length on off, Buttler pushes it through covers. With another single, Buttler keeps the strike.
Broad now makes room, Ishant bowls it way outside off. Broad reaches out for it and gets it off the toe end towards deep point for a run. 31 shy of the 300-run mark now, England.
Short again on off, Broad guides it towards point.
Shortish in length outside off, Buttler chops it towards point for a run.

FOUR! Right in the gap! Buttler moves into the 40s, also it brings up the 50-run stand between the two. Another annoying stand for the Indians but a vital one for England. This is full and on the pads, Buttler flicks it through square leg and the ball races away.

Buttler walks down the wicket and also shuffles across to cover the swing. But the ball comes back in very sharply. Jos is cut into half and there is a noise as the ball goes between bat and pad. There is a stifled appeal from the Indians but nothing from the umpire. The noise was of the bat hitting the pad.
Ishant Sharma is back on.

FOUR! That's a shot even a top order batsman will be proud of. Shami keeps it a bit short of good length, Broad transfers his wait on the front foot and makes contact with the ball simultaneously, hence it's superbly timed. The ball flies past mid on's right and races to the boundary. England going well.

Beats the bat again as Broad flashes at a length ball outside off. Shami might not have beaten the batsmen so many times in a single innings in his life! It might be some kind of a record - Most misses induced or most deliveries beating the bat, may be?
Broad shoulders arms to this wide of off delivery.
A bit shorter in length outside off, Jos punches this off the back foot into the cover-point region to add a run.
Lands it fuller but outside off, Buttler leaves.
A good length this and also a very good line around off. However, Jos' current form is too good to get beaten by this. He defends solidly.
Punches this one into the cover region for yet another easy single. Not impressive this from the visitors.
Tapped towards point. No run.
A flatter and shorter in length ball outside off is cut fiercely into the point region and Buttler adds a brace to the total.
A bit slower and straighter. Buttler defends off the front foot.
Fuller on his pads, Broad flicks it to square leg to pick up another run.
Easy runs here for Buttler. India leaking runs. Jadeja bowls this short and outside off, Buttler punches through covers to take a single.
Strays on his pads, Broad taps it to square leg.
A bit shorter outside off, Buttler rocks back and punches it into the cover region to pick up another run.
Outside off, left alone.

Leading edge but safe. Keeps it on a length on the middle stump line. The ball lands and moves away from the batsman. Broad looking to work it into the leg side is squared up because of the movement and gets a leading edge. The ball flies over Shami's head and falls in between mid on and mid off. They take a single.
Fuller but too wide again. Broad points his bat skywards.
Shami starts his first over after the break with a short ball but he has banged it well wide of off stump. Broad has absolutely no issues in leaving it alone.
Too wide outside off and an easy leave for Jos. A pretty harmless first over by RJ.

FOUR! Very poor delivery by Jadeja. Drops it short and wide outside off, Buttler picks his area and whacks it square of the wicket on the off side. A boundary results. Vital runs these. 250 up for England, they still have two wickets in hand, how many more can they add?
Buttler has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Broad got forward to drive and played it wide of backward point for three runs.
Flighted and full around off, Broad lunges and defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.

Drinks break. England have done well so far to survive the first hour by losing only one wicket. Jos Buttler is holding one end firmly and is adding vital runs to the total. A bit frustrating for India as once again they are struggling to get rid of the English tail. Change in plans now from the tourists, Ravindra Jadeja to bowl...
The left-hander shows the full face of the bat and defends this straight ball off the back foot.
Buttler flicks this fuller one on middle towards the mid-wicket region and takes a single.
A bit short on off, defended well off the back foot by Jos.
A bit too wide of off to entice the batsman into a shot.
Gets a bit too straight, Buttler works it into the mid-wicket region to come back for a brace.

Unlucky Shami! Beats the batsman again but is still wicket-less in the innings. Lands this one on a good length just outside off. Buttler looking to score quick runs goes for the big booming drive through the off side. But the ball moves away on landing and beats Buttler's bat.
Broad gets rapped on the pads but survives. Bumrah keeps it in line with the stumps. Broad tries to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Too wide of off, left alone.
Pulls the length back a bit and keeps it around off. Buttler rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball towards the cover-point region. One run added to the total.
On the pads, flicked away into the square leg region for a single.

Nasty! Banged in short angling towards Broad's head who does really well to duck under it at the last moment. Pant behind, leaps like a frog to pouch it with his left glove. Nice take that by the young keeper.
Looks like Buttler has confidence in Broad. He takes a single off the first ball by tapping it into the point region for a single.
Beaten outside off. keeps this one shorter of good length. It lands and moves away to beat Broad's outside edge.
Short of a length on off, Buttler taps this one towards point to pick up a single.
Beauty! Shami gets this one to land in the corridor of uncertainty. The ball pitches and moves away. Buttler, tries to go for the drive on the up but is beaten.
A bit shorter of a length on off, Broad, at the very last moment, opens his bat face and runs it down towards the third man region for another single.

Much better from Shami as he lands this one on a good length on the middle and off line, with some away movement. Buttler does well to block it and the ball rolls towards the cover region. They take a quick single.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. He shoulders arms.
Shami comes in to bowl.
Wide of off, left alone.
Bouncer! Broad has been hit on the gloves but the ball drops just besides his feet.. Good change of length from JB.

Four leg byes! Bumrah misses his line and length on this one as he fires a knee high full toss at Broad's body. Luckily for the batsman, the ball swings in too much, brushes his thigh pad and runs down towards fine leg for a boundary.
Nice shot by Broad. Good length delivery around off stump, Stuart comes on the front foot and punches it through covers to take a brace.
Strays on his pads, Broad tries to tuck it around but does not get bat on ball.
Starts off with a rib-tickler, which surprises Broad. Bangs it in on the leg stump line, but the angle is taking the ball across the batsman. Broad sways back a bit and lets the ball go past him.
Shorter in length and on the body. Broad gets inside the line and tucks it with the angle to deepish fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! That will instill some confidence in the English pacer. Ishant keeps this fuller outside off. Broad comes forward and creams the drive through covers for a boundary.
Lands this one very full on off, Broad drives it politely to mid off with soft hands.
Shortish again outside off, Buttler slaps it through covers for a run.
Short again on off, Broad pushes it towards covers for a run.
Back of a length on off, defended towards point. This time Kohli has that man in the ring.
From around the wicket, he bangs it on a length around off. Broad tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
Another edge which goes wide of the second slip fielder. Virat though has a man at third man this time and only a single results.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

EDGED AND FOUR! Back of a length on off, Buttler, away from his body, tries to push it through the off side. The ball takes the outside edge and goes just wide of the diving second slip fielder and into the fence.

Full and outside off, Broad square drives it through the off side for a run. Don't understand why Kohli had that man in the deep, Broad gets off the mark on his first ball. More importantly for England, Buttler is back on strike.
Stuart Broad is the new man in.

OUT! The angle does not save him as the ball is clipping the leg pole and it is the umpire's call. England, however, do not lose a review. India though get the breakthrough they so desperately wanted today morning. End of a frustrating 33-run stand for them. Bumrah comes running in and bowls it around off, this one jags back in after pitching. Rashid is rooted in his crease as he tries to block it out but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire, after a while, raises his finger. Rashid walks up to his partner and after a chat, takes the referral. Replays show that the ball is not missing the stumps and the impact is well in the line of the stumps. Rashid has to continue his walk back to the pavilion.
Up goes the finger and Rashid has been given his marching orders. He, though, has decided to review it. Looks close, however, the angle can just save him.
Better, again bowls the straighter one on off, Buttler however gets right behind the line and defends it.
Gets this one to hold its line but it is a little too wide. Buttler opts not to play at it.
Another inswinger, maybe Sharma becoming a little too predictable here. Rashid waits for it and then tucks it with the movement towards square leg for a run.
Fuller again on middle, Rashid tries to drive it to mid on but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
BYE! Another inswinger but Ishant errs in line. Bowls it down the leg side. Pant dives but fails to stop it cleanly, a bye is taken.
A typical fast bowler's response, goes for a boundary on the last ball, this time he bangs it short, tries to roughen the batsman up. Rashid however, is up to the task and ducks under it.
FOUR! Excellent use of the wrists there. Full and on middle, with the angle, Rashid flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away. That went to the fence very quickly, no soul moved there.
Third ball in a row which is outside off, Adil makes his third leave in a row. Bumrah not as effective as he was yesterday till now.
Another ball a little too wide outside off, Rashid shoulders arms to it.
Slightly outside off, Rashid need not play at those.
Nicely driven but there is a fielder in the deep. Jasprit bowls it full and outside off, Buttler hits it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Good length again, Buttler pushes it towards mid off and takes an easy run.
Goes full again on off, Buttler strokes it crisply to mid off.

Howzzat? Doing a little too much. Another good decision. Full and tailing back in from off. Buttler misses the flick to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Hawk Eye later confirms that it would have missed the leg pole.
A short ball on middle, Rashid gets on top of the bounce and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flicks it with the swing towards fine leg and takes a run.
Sharma lands this on a length just outside off. Buttler tries to drive it hard through covers but the ball moves in on pitching. Buttler mistimes his drive to mid off.
Similar ball from Bumrah and Rashid blocks this one from within the crease.
Good length delivery on the middle and off line, the ball lands and moves in this time. Rashid gets a bit cramped up for room but keeps it away in the end.
Beaten! That is much better from Jasprit. He lands this one on a length just on the off stump line and gets it to move away on pitching. Rashid looks to block it but gets beaten due to the deviation.
Length ball on middle is defended from the crease.

Better from Bumrah, keeps this one a bit shorter of good length on the off stump line. The ball hits the deck and nips away slightly. Buttler does well to wait for the ball to arrive, account for the away movement and tap it into the cover-point region. The batsmen take a single and exchange strike.
JB starts the over with a good length delivery outside off. The ball lands and seams further away but it is too wide to trouble Buttler, who leaves it alone.

Another excellent delivery to end another excellent over by Ishant. Once again though, he is guilty of bowling it slightly short outside off. The ball tails back in late. Rashid is forward in an attempt to defend but misses to get hit near the box.
On off, this one is kept out.
Tries an another inswinger but this does not move. Rashid shoulders arms to it.

A huge appeal but not given! The Indians are not happy and rightly so as that looked very, very close. Ishant bowls this one a touch fuller than the previous delivery. Also gets this one to come back in. Rashid seems to have missed the ball as it hits him on the front pad. The Indians are pleading but the umpire stays put. Virat Kohli can't believe it but he can't do anything as they have no reviews left. Hold on now... replays later on show, even if India would have had a review, they would have lost it as Snicko detects an inside edge. So, we need to give credit where it's due, excellent decision by umpire Dharmasena.
On a length again and around off, Rashid defends it.

Gets this one to tail back in but it is slightly short, Rashid misses the flick and is hit high on the pads. Ishant needs to get it a touch fuller as he is getting a little extra bounce due to his height.
Rashid keeps the strike with the single! The in-dipper by Bumrah. Rashid taps it towards point and takes a brisk single.
Good change in length there, the surprise bumper. Rashid, however, is seeing the ball well out there and he is quick to duck under it.
And again rocks back and defends it right underneath his eyes. Rashid looks really confident in the four balls he has faced.
Better from Bumrah. On a length and around off, Rashid is solid in defense.
On the pads, Rashid fails to clip it away. It brushes his pads and goes towards the keeper. Two looseners to begin with by Bumrah.

FOUR! Classical shot there! First runs of the day and it comes in the form of a boundary. A stylish shot to bring up the 200. Full and outside off, Rashid needs no sighters. He plants his front foot forward and strokes it through covers for a boundary.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.
Finishes a very good first over with a big booming inswinger. From outside off this one comes back in sharply. Buttler tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.

A mild appeal but nothing from the umpire. Down the leg side. Buttler misses the flick, the ball brushes his pads and Pant behind takes it by diving to his left. The players appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
Nicely bowled! Length again outside off, the outswinger this time. Buttler chases it but does not put bat on it. So Buttler is straightaway looking to score.
Slightly fuller and closer to the off pole. No swing this time. Buttler strokes it to mid off.

Play and a miss! The only reason I see Buttler having a poke at that was due to the previous ball. The last one came in, this one is also pitched around off but straightens. Buttler could have left it but he felt it was coming back in. He hangs his bat out and luckily for him gets beaten.
Starts off with an inswinger but bowls it a little too wide outside off, Ishant was looking for the banana swing there. Does not get it and Buttler makes an easy leave.

We are all set for the action to begin. Out come the Indian players along with the umpires. They are followed by, the birthday boy, Jos Buttler and Adil Rashid who will resume their innings. Ishant Sharma has the second new ball in his hand which is relatively new. He has two slips in place. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Sanjay Manjrekar says, it's not as cold as yesterday and the conditions are slightly overcast but there is no fear of rain. Regarding the surface, he feels the Indian seamers bowled superbly on the opening day, used the conditions well and troubled the English batsmen. However, he also states that because of the Indian pacers' footmarks, especially Ishant Sharma's, a lot of rough has been created. Ends by saying that the most important battle will be the one between the English spinners, mainly Moeen Ali, and the Indian batsmen.

Ishant Sharma, being interviewed on the boundary ropes, says it was a bit of a roller-coaster ride yesterday. Reckons that there was nothing in the wicket during the first session but later on, as the game progressed, the wicket got slightly quicker. Admits that both his colleagues, Shami and Bumrah, bowled really well and maintained constant pressure on the English batsmen. Mentions that they were always in the game as they did not allow the home team to score easily and gain control. States that they were just focusing on bowling in the right areas. Ends by saying that his stint at Sussex before the tour has helped him a lot and has made the biggest difference in his bowling.

Nonetheless, the hosts would now hope that their highest run-getter of the series, Jos Buttler, with some able support from the 'tail', takes them out of the danger zone and put up a fighting total on the board. The touring team, in contrast, would be keen on winding up the English innings as soon as possible before shifting their focus towards their willows.

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of Day 2 of this 5th Test between the hosts, England, and India. So, after being behind the eight ball for a major part of the day, the bragging rights for the opening day were seized by the visitors.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

The day, however, could have turned even better for the visitors had Buttler not taken the review after being given out LBW. An inside edge, which was surprising to many, saved him. He though now holds the key for England. He has Rashid along with him, who is no mug with the bat and England would hope the two can take them somewhere close to 250. Whereas, India will look to bundle out the remaining wickets as soon as possible. We now take your leave from Day 1, join us for all the action on Day 2 at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care.

Though, that was not to be as Bumrah got rid of the well set Cook which opened the flood gates. Root and Bairstow were sent back for a duck each. Stokes and Ali did try to steady the ship but Jadeja then struck to get rid of Ben. Ishant then dismissed Ali and Curran in the same over. The tall fast bowler ended up being India's bowler of the day as he finished with a three-fer.

This session - 31 overs, 75 runs and 6 wickets. Probably the session which India needed, probably the session which turns the tide in their favor. After winning the toss and electing to bat, Cook and Jennings got off to an ideal start. The two added a 50-run stand and after that, Moeen and Cook both lived a charmed life and added another 50+ stand. Both got to their half tons and England entered the third session eyeing a big first innings total.

Another excellent yorker and it seems as though he has dug it out well. However, the Indians feel that the ball has hit his toe first and they go up in an appeal. The umpire is unmoved and Rashid survives. Replays show that the ball has hit the middle of his bat. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY ONE!
Tries to attack the stumps but overdoes it and strays it down the leg side. Adil tries flicking it but misses. Rishabh does well to pouch it behind.
Keeps it a bit outside off, and Rashid is happy to leave it alone.
Smart from Bumrah as he goes for the block hole and executes it well. However, Rashid is alert enough to get his bat down in time and dig it out.

Half-hearted appeal by the touring team, declined by the umpire. Lands this one very full outside off. Adil reaches for the ball, misses it and Pant collects the nut behind and politely asks the question. Replays show that the ball bounced over the bat by a margin.
Good start to the final over of the day. Keeps it very full on off. The ball has a bit of an away shape on it. Rashid does well to account for it and block it out.
Length ball outside off, Jos points his bat skywards.
Shami fires this one a bit straighter in line with the stumps. Buttler leans across and flicks it towards the square leg region to add a brace to the total.
Lands it shorter around off, defended off the back foot by Buttler.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Strays a bit on the batsman's pads, Jos flicks it towards mid-wicket and they change strike.
Shami starts the penultimate over of the day with a length ball outside off. Buttler has nothing to do with it.
Too wide of off to tempt Rashid into a shot.
Rashid has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Full ball on off is defended with a straight bat.
FOUR! Keeps it a bit shorter of a good length around off, Adil stays back in his crease, opens the bat face at the very last moment and glides the ball through the vacant gully area for a boundary.

Leg bye! Jasprit starts the over by keeping it on a good length around off, angling into Buttler. He tries to work it into the leg side with the angle but gets beaten and the ball raps him on his front pad and gets deflected into the cover region. The batsmen run a leg bye to exchange strike.
The second new ball has been taken! Three overs to go in the day, can they get the remaining three wickets with it? Let us see.
On a length around off, Rashid blocks it onto the ground.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Nudges it around the corner and the batsmen take one.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.

NOT OUT! And guess what? An inside edge saves him there. Buttler survives to fight another day. The crowd here erupts. Shami bowls it full and gets it to tail back in. Buttler tries to flick but he seems to have missed it. The ball hits him on the pads, the players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Buttler asks his partner and then goes for the review. Time for the replays and to everybody's surprise it shows an inside edge.
Review time! Buttler has been given out LBW but he reviews it. Looks out unless there is an inside edge.
Back of a length on off, Buttler blocks it out.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
A big indipper on off, Rashid at the very last moment hits it towards long on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length again on off, Rashid gets behind the line and keeps it out.
FOUR BYES! Another one down the leg side, it swings away further. Pant once again has no chance and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
On off, this one comes in with the angle. Rashid defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Rashid defends it onto the ground.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
FOUR! Trademark Buttler! Sharma bowls it just ahead of a length on off, Buttler leans into it and times it through covers for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Well, even if it had carried, it would not have made a difference as there was no bat involved there. However, a good ball by Ishant. He bowls a big inswinger. It comes in like a banana. Buttler hops and tries to keep it out but misses. The ball goes off something and lobs towards the slip cordon where Kohli takes it and appeals. The umpire though is not sure and I feel he goes upstairs for the catch. Replays roll in and they show a big gap between bat and ball. Buttler survives.
Has that been taken cleanly? The Indians surely feel so but the umpire has taken it upstairs. The soft signal is out.
Outside off, Buttler again leaves it.
Good length again outside off, Buttler opts not to play with it.
On a length around off, Buttler pushes it to covers.
Third leave in a row as it is once again bowled outside off.
Fires it just outside off, Rashid lets it be.
Turn there but way outside off, Rashid shoulders arms to it.
Floats it up on off, Rashid pushes it to covers.
That has crisply been driven towards covers but for no runs.
Flighted ball on off, Buttler strokes it through covers and takes a run.
Fuller around off, Rashid gets forward and blocks it out.
Adil Rashid is the new man in the middle.

OUT! A beauty again! Two in an over for the visitors and that's a second in this innings. It's a big one as England's star all-rounder of the series, Sam Curran, is gone for a duck. Ishant keeps this one a bit shorter of the good length area outside the off stump line. Curran goes back, looking to leave the ball. However, his decision to leave it is a bit too late as the ball kisses the bottom of his half-raised bat and Rishabh Pant does the rest for the tourists. England in a hole now. Will India bat today?

Four Byes! Banged in short, too short rather. Also it's a bit too wide down leg. Sharma completely misses his radar on this one. Pant tries hard to scamper, dive and stop it but fails. It's been a tough day for the young Indian keeper.
Curran is the new batsman in.

OUT! What a rippa! Sharma is rewarded for his persistence and consistency. Patience, that's the word.  India now are right back in the match. Getting back to the delivery, Sharma keeps this one on a length just marginally outside off. However, his angle from around the wicket entices Ali into a defensive push. The ball straightens on pitching, takes the faintest of edges and finishes in Pant's mitts. England lose their sixth.
Similar delivery is given the same treatment. Rishabh collects.
Sharma starts the new over with a fuller than good length delivery outside off. Moeen leaves it alone.
On off, blocked.

Fifty for Moeen Ali, his 13th in Tests. He has justified his selection with the ball in the last game and now contributing with the bat. Also, making a point as to why he should be batting at the no. 3 position. Not to forget, he was dropped on 2 and now he is making India pay for that. He whips this through mid-wicket and takes a run. He raises his bat to the pavilion.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Down the leg side and Ali lets it be.
Floats it up on off, Moeen tucks it to mid-wicket.
Uses his feet and works it to mid on.
This time he bowls it a touch too straight. Moeen flicks it through mid-wicket and runs two.
Outside off, Ali leaves it. This has not been such a great over by Ishant, he has either bowled too wide or too short.
A bumper and Moeen ducks under it.
BEAUTY! On a length around off, it pitches and straightens. Ali tries to keep it out but gets beaten.
The bumper on middle, Moeen ducks under it.
A little too wide outside off, the batsman lets it be. The new ball is no available but has not been taken.
Flighted ball outside off, Buttler tries to slap it through the off side but gets an under edge to covers. Jadeja seems to be bowling a little slow to the right-hander.
Misfield and a few extra runs to England! On off, Buttler squeezes it towards point. The fielder there dives over the ball and the batsmen run two.
Outside off, left alone.
Again slower through the air on off, Buttler pushes it to mid off.
Floats it up on off, Buttler keeps it out.
Slower through the air on middle, Ali works it through square leg and takes a single.
Sharma ends the over with a tight line and length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty. But the attacking batsman gets behind the ball and blocks it solidly.
Buttler shoulders arms to this ball wide of off stump.
A bit shorter and a bit outside off this, Buttler goes back and taps it into the point region.
Buttler gets right behind the line of this one and keeps it out.

Beaten! Beauty from Sharma. Lands this one on a length just outside off. Buttler, seeing the initial angle on the delivery, gets sucked into a shot and tries to push at the ball. The nut pitches and nips away, beats the right-hander's outside edge. Sharma continues to impress.
Sharma keeps the first ball of the over fuller outside off. Buttler watchfully lets it go past him.
Off the mark with a flick through the leg side for a run.

OUT! Plumb in front! Jadeja gets his second and England have half the side back in the hut. Stokes walks back for yet another low score. Jadeja spears this in very full and quite quick. It was almost a yorker. Stokes just did not read the length there. He was initially looking to go for the sweep but then realized the shot is not on. He tried to adjust but was late to do so. The bat did not come down in time and the ball pings him on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger.
Jos Buttler is the new man in.
That stayed low! That was really well played by Stokes. It pitches on off and then shoots along the ground. Stokes gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Eases it through mid on and takes a run.
Flatter on off, Moeen defends it onto the ground.
Very full on off, Moeen Ali works it to mid-wicket.
Short of a length again on middle, Stokes defends it onto the ground.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Back of a length on off, Ben defends it onto the ground.
Good length outside off, Stokes lets it be.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length outside off, left alone.
Ishant Sharma is back on.
On off, Stokes defends it onto the ground.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.
FOUR! Tickled and tickled fine! On the pads, Stokes works it through short fine leg and the ball races away.
Floats it up on off, Ben lunges forward and defends it.
Uses his feet and whips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full on the pads, Moeen works it to mid-wicket.
On off, Stokes defends it on the ground.
On the pads, it is worked fine down the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Caressed! A half-volley and Moeen Ali times it through covers. Need not run for those and Ali is now in the 40s.
BEATEN AGAIN! Moeen Ali has really rode his luck. Those play and misses will be so frustrating for Shami. Again he bowls it full and outside off, Ali goes for the drive but gets beaten.
Good length again outside off, MA shoulders arms again.
On a length outside off, Moeen Ali makes a leave. This has been an innings in which he has shown a lot of patience.

Drinks! What a passage of play for the visitors! They have made their way back into this match by taking three important wickets. They would look to pick up some more and dent the home team's batting line-up before the end of play today. England, on the other hand, would want both their southpaws to build a strong partnership and hold fort till the last ball is bowled today. The third session to resume in a short while, hang around!
Fires it on off, Stokes keeps it out. Ufff! How quick was that over bowled? Just Jadeja things.
Goes back and works it to mid-wicket with the turn.
Quicker on off, Stokes goes back and guides it to covers.
Slightly shorter on off, Ali rocks back and works it with the turn through mid-wicket for a run.
floats it up on off, Jadeja strokes it to mid on.
On off, kept out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Toe-Crusher! Clever thinking by Shami as he tries to take the batsman by surprise by firing in a yorker on the middle and leg line. Stokes though does well to dig it out at the last moment.
Way outside off, Stokes shoulders arms.

FOUR! Crisp from Stokes. Shami lands this one full and just outside off. Stokes comes forward, crouches a bit and creams this drive through covers for a magnificent boundary. The home team need Stokes to hang around for longer and play a substantial innings.
Shami keeps it on a length outside off, Stokes comes forward to defend, taps it towards the point region and takes a single.

Four Byes! Shami starts this over from around the wicket with a length ball angling into the batsman. The ball is constantly moving inwards in the air. The prodigious movement takes the ball past Moeen's pads and keeps going with the angle. Pant behind has no chance to stop it as he is seen fake diving to his right but the ball is way wide and goes to the boundary for four byes. Kee a count of the extra's conceeded today.
Good running! Ali tucks it besides the pitch and goes for a run. Jadeja quickly gets to the ball and fires it to the keeper but Stokes makes it in.
Good running! Ali tucks it besides the pitch and goes for a run. Jadeja quickly gets to the ball and fires it to the keeper but Stokes makes it in.
Fires it outside off and gets it to turn into the batsman. Ali tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Impact outside off.
Uses his feet and slams it straight back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Very wide outside off, left alone.
Clever stuff! Sees the batsman dancing down the track and bowls it a touch short. Moeen tries to work it across the line but is beaten to get hit on the pads.
Back of a length on off, Stokes defends it onto the ground.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
On the fuller side, Stokes plays it through the off side and takes a single.
FOUR BYES! No chance for Pant. The lad has had a tough time behind the stumps today. This is down the leg side and it swings away further. Pant has no chance as the ball crosses the fine leg fence.
Back of a length on off, Moeen guides it towards point and takes a run.
Lovely bowling again! He has been excellent till now. He again angles this into the off pole first and then gets it to leave the batsman. Ali tries to defend but is beaten.
On the stumps again, Stokes defends it solidly.
On off, Stokes keeps it out.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
With the turn works it to mid on.
On off, Moeen Ali blocks it onto the ground.
Flatter on off, Moeen goes back and defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Stokes stands tall and defends it out.
Lovely bowling! Back of a length outside off, Stokes half-heartedly tries to defend it but gets beaten.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Stokes again gives the bowler the charge and defends it towards point.
Another ball outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
On the pads, it is flicked very fine, just past the leg slip fielder for a brace.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Tosses it outside off, Moeen lunges forward and pushes it through covers for a run.
On the pads, Stokes nudges it towards square leg and takes a single.
Down the leg side and the batsman lets it be.
Works it around the corner with the turn and takes a run.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
Outside off, left alone by Stokes.
Full length ball is driven to mid off.

Big appeal, turned down. India can't review it as they don't have any left. Sharma from around the wicket fires this one into Stokes and keeps it on a good length on off. Stokes, seen walking towards the bowler, leans across and tries to flick it through mid-wicket. But the ball has pitched and it seams in prodigiously to beat the bat and he gets raped on the front pad. India appeal but the umpire disagrees. The ball was going down the leg side.
Way outside off, Stokes raises his bat and watches the ball go behind.
A bit full but way wide of off, Stokes shoulders arms.

Jaffa! Ishant lands this on a length just outside off from around the wicket. The initial angle into Stokes tempts him in pushing at the ball. But the nut hits the deck and moves away from the all rounder who gets beaten.
Ali gets right behind this short of a length ball around off and blocks it under his eyes.
Good length on off again, the left hander played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Ali has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bumrah fires it down the leg side, Moeen tries flicking it but misses. Pant collects it behind.
Lands it a bit short of good length, Ali defends off the back foot.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.

EDGED but does not carry! The Indians can sniff another wicket here. Stokes tries to cover the swing by walking down the track. He tries to drive it down the ground but the ball takes the outside edge and lands just in front of the diving slip fielder. End of an excellent over by Ishant, a wicket and a run from it.
LOVELY STUFF! This is the delivery with which he so often gets the southpaws out. On a length and around off, it pitches and moves away. Stokes is forward in defense but is beaten by the movement.
Ben Stokes walks out to the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! One brings two, two brings three. The Indians are on fire here and Jonny Bairstow once again walks back for a duck. This is his third duck in three consecutive Tests. From 133-1, England are now 134-4. Ishant gets his first. Excellent bowling by the tall fast bowler. He was constantly getting the ball to come back in but this time he gets it to straighten after pitching it on off. Bairstow plays inside the line, the ball takes the outside edge and goes into the mitts of the keeper. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger.
Closer to the off pole this time and tailing back in. Jonny gets right behind it and defends it.
Gets some shape into the right-hander this time. It is outside off. JB makes a good leave.
On the pads, looking for the swing away but does not get it. Ali flicks it through backward square leg and takes a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Jonny Bairstow is the new man in.

OUT! Boom Boom Bumrahhhh! Double strike for the pacer and the visitors and it's the big one - the England captain. Jasprit Bumrah lands this one on a good length just a bit outside off. The ball lands and seams in considerably. Root, stuck in his crease, tries to push at the ball with his bat in front of his body. The inward nip beats Joe's inside edge and raps him right in front, or at least it looked like it was right in front. But the umpire does not move for about 10 secs and as we start to think that Root has survived, (India have no reviews in the bag) the umpire raises his finger at the very last moment. Root after a word with his partner goes for the review. Replays roll in. Snicko shows no involvement of the bat but Hawk Eye shows the ball crashing into the middle and leg pole. The umpire has to reverse his decision, Root has to take the long walk back and India have made a come-back, through Bumrah.
Have India got another? The umpire has given Root out LBW but he has challenged the decision. Looks plumb, only an inside edge can save him.
Keeps it in line with the stumps, Joe gets behind the line of the ball and keeps it out.
The ball is too wide on the off side for Root to try and make any contact.
Joe Root is the next batsman in.

OUT! INDIA GET A BREAKTHROUGH! That too of the most experienced English player! Can the touring team pick up a few more and throw the cat among the pigeons? Bumrah is the man who is rewarded as he lands it a bit shorter of good length just outside off. Cook, seeing the ball a bit shorter of a length, goes back and tries to keep it out. The ball hits the deck, skids back into Cook who gets cramped for room. The ball takes the inner edge as Cook is late to get his bat down in time. The ball, for the delight of the visitors, crashes into the timber. Very important and a timely wicket for the tourists. Cook makes his way out and the entire Oval crowd stands and applauds this legend.
Lands this one on a length in line with the stumps. The former England captain blocks it out off the front foot.

Much better from Ishant. Keeps this one full around off. It moves away slightly on pitching. The length is such that the batsman is not sure whether to come forward or go back. Ali is in a similar confusion and due to the lack of footwork is beaten by the away movement.
Bowls it full but the line is too wide to entice Ali into a lose shot. He leaves it alone.
Ali shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Moeen.
A bit shorter outside off from Sharma, Cook stands tall and punches it through the covers and adds a run to the English total.
Length on off, defends it from within the crease.

Beaten again! Someone count the number of times the batsman has got beaten without edging the ball. Lands this one a bit fuller outside off. Ali comes forward to block it but the ball lands and seams away beating the bat's edge. This is called Test cricket for exactly the same reason. It's a true test of someone's patience and temperament.
Pulls his length back marginally, angling into Ali who stays in his crease and blocks it out.
Attacking the stumps, Ali keeps it out off the front foot.
Lands it on a length but the line is wide of off. This allows Ali to point his bat skywards and watchfully see the ball go past him.
Very full on off, defended off the front foot.
Length ball angling into the pads, turns it into the leg side with the inward angle for a single.
Another ball on the pads and it is once again played on the leg side for a run.
Again angles it onto the pads, Ali flicks it through square leg and takes one.
Tucks it around the corner and gets to the other end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length on off, Cook defends it onto the ground.

NOT OUT! A poor, poor review from India there. That always looked high and that turned out to be the case. Both reviews have gone down the drain. Ishant bowls it on a length around middle, Cook hops and tries to clip it but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire shakes his head. Kohli probably on the 14th second signals for 'T'. The replays roll in and it shows the ball to be going over.
A late review taken by Kohli. An LBW decision against Cook has been challenged. Looks high.
Ishant Sharma will bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Ends the over in style! Poor delivery by Bumrah, on the pads, Ali is too good a batsman to miss out there. He flicks it through square leg and the ball races away.
Play and a miss! How many times have we seen that happen today? Another length around off, it pitches and moves away. Moeen plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Down the leg side, Ali lets it go. Pant dives and collects it really well.
Length again on off, it again shapes away. Cook guides it towards point and takes a brisk single. Jadeja did have a shy at the bowlers end but misses.
On a length again around off, this one pitches and straightens a touch. Cook tries to defend but it goes off the outer half towards point.
Starts off with a loosener outside off, Cook leaves it.
We are back for the final session! 31 overs left in the day. Alastair Cook and Moeen Ali will resume their innings. Jasprit Bumrah will start the proceedings for India. Here we go...
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

On the other hand, the Indian bowlers did try their best but not a lot is on offer on this wicket. They will need to break this stand and put pressure on the out of form English middle order as soon as possible. Will the visitors fight back? Join us after the break to find out.

We have witnessed another excellent session, a wicket less one, for the home side. They are marching forward towards a big first innings total. Cook continued from where he left off after the break. He is making India pay for the reprieve he got. Moeen, also after being dropped, has now got his eye in and the hosts would dearly like this association to continue after the Tea interval.

A length ball around, Alastair, looking to flick it into the leg side, gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls down towards the cover-point region and the batsmen run through for a run. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 1!
Very full ball is driven straight to mid off.

Good patience shown by Cook. He is respecting the good deliveries and punishing the bad ones. He's looking in real good touch. Does he really have to retire? Looking too good to have done that though!
Lands this one short again  in line with the stumps. Cook rocks back and keeps it out with ease.
Fuller outside off, the left hander shoulders arms.
Sharma lands this one fractionally behind a good length, Cook stands tall and blocks it under his eye line.
Ali flicks this one to mid on with a wristy shot.
A bit slower and shorter on off, Cook gets across the line and whips this through mid-wicket to get a single.
Jadeja keeps firing it on his legs and the southpaws are creaming their drives into the off side with not much of a trouble.
Full again on the stumps, flicked straight to mid-wicket again.
A bit flatter on the pads, worked down towards square leg.
Very full, flicked towards mid-wicket.
A shorter ball is treated well by going back and defending with a straight bat, under his eyes.
This full ball on the stumps is blocked out off the front foot by Ali.
A bit short of a good length, defended off the back foot.
Bouncer, tries to surprise with the change in length. But Ali ducks under it easily.
Keeps it in the same area, Ali blocks it out comfortably.
Sharma starts the new spell with a good length ball in the corridor, Ali shows respect and defends it.
Ishant Sharma comes into the attack.
Flatter and fuller ball is driven through mid-wicket.

FOUR! Cook seems to be loving this. He's getting a lose delivery every once in a while and a batsman of his caliber will not miss out many times on such deliveries. Jadeja lands it a bit short outside off, Cook gets his fierce cut out and gets the ball racing across the deep point boundary.
A bit slower on the middle stump line, turned away towards the mid-wicket region.
Full ball fired at the batsman's legs, Cook leans and drives it through mid on.
Flatter on off, this one pitches and skids straight on, Cook defends well with a straight bat.
Fuller around off, Cook lunges forward to keep this out.
Full on off, driven back to the bowler.
Outside off, left alone.

Goodness me, how many times has Ali failed to edge the ball in this session and that too against Shami? Countless. He plays away from his body once again but fails to connect. Shami has stopped showing any disappointment now as he is unable to get Ali edge one.
Full and straight, Cook drives it down the ground for a run.
in the same channel and Cook keeps it out.
Shortish around off, defended.
Fuller on off, driven crisply but straight to mid on.
A bit shorter and blocked out off the back foot by Moeen.
Ali defends it from within the crease.
Lands this one a bit shorter, Cook goes back and punches it through covers to get a run.
Similar delivery, kept out easily by Cook.
Flatter and fuller, defended off the front foot by the Chef. He's looking comfortable and set for a big one. Ominous signs for the visitors.
Way outside off, left alone.
Guess what? Fifth one in a line. A bit shorter around off, Ali continues to poke outside off and continues to get beaten. 5 out of 5, this might be a record of some kind...
That's unbelievable! It's a fourth miss in a row by Ali. Shami looks up and Kohli seems in disbelief. Ali is still out there.
Third in a row, a hat-trick of misses. Similar ball to the previous one and a similar result.
A bit shorter outside off, Ali keeps his bat near his body as the ball whizzes past his bat.
The same story continues. Shami angles it in around off. It lands and nips away beating the batsman's tentative poke. The tourists must be praying for some luck.
Quicker and a bit shorter on off, defended off the back foot
Fuller one is driven to mid on.
Full toss on his pads, Cook misses out as he gets a bit surprised with the length and punches it very late towards mid on. No run on offer.
Fires it down the leg side, Pant collects.
Flatter and fuller on the stumps is worked towards mid-wicket.
Jadeja starts a fresh over with a shortish delivery outside off. Cook punches it through covers and picks up a couple of runs.
A slight delay as the tourists have asked for some protection gear for their fielder at short leg.

There has been a pattern with Ali against Shami. He has played numberous times and missed almost 80 percent of the time. A short of a length ball outside off, Moeen hangs his bat but again, no outside edge. Shami is almost frustrated now.
And this one leaves Ali from the short of a length area. Shami has been so good in this session and yet nothing to show for it.
In line of the stumps, Cook gets it to the on side off the inner half of the bat for another single.
Flicks the fuller ball through mid-wicket for a run.
Comes closer to the off pole and lands this one a length. Ali gets behind the line to defend it.
Short of a length ball outside off, Ali fails to connect to it.
A similar delivery is tucked towards mid-wicket.
Flatter and fuller on off, driven to mid on. No run on offer.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Lovely Shot! That's so pleasing to the eyes. Jadeja lands it too full this time. Cook picks up the length early, transfers his weight forward and creams this drive through the mid on region for a beautiful boundary. Fifty run stand comes up. Another vital stand for the home team and it has given a strong base to their innings to build up a large first innings total.
Flatter on the stumps, Cook looks to punch it through covers but the ball lands and spins in a bit to get the inside edge onto his pads and deflects towards covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Similar ball to the one with which he started the over. Keeps it fuller around off and gets some away movement. Ali's poke is beaten again.
Ali defends it from within the crease.
Comes behind the line of this good length ball on off and keeps it out.
Ali chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Moeen shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shami keeps it a bit fuller and wide of off. Ali throws his hands at it, hoping to get good connection but he misses it completely. Another one goes past the bat.
The England legend flicks it away into the mid-wicket region with a wristy shot.
Wide down the leg side, no trouble at all for Cook to let it go alone.
Ali works this straighter ball down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This time he leaves this one alone which is straying down the leg.
Fires this one down the leg side. Cook tries to flick but misses.
Fuller on the off stump, driven through mid on by Cook. Two runs added to the total. And that's yet another half century for the experienced Englishman in his last game.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.

Beaten, again! Shami looks up to the sky as if to ask Him - When will I find the edge? He lands this one on a length around off, Cook tentatively comes forward to block it out. The ball  lands and nips away slightly, enough to beat Cook's outside edge. India still searching for that wicket.
A bit fuller and straighter in line, Ali drives it a bit wide of mid on to change the strike.
Ali shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
A bit shorter and just outside off. Cook taps it late towards the point region.
A bit shorter this time, kept out off the back foot.
Keeps it fuller on middle, driven softly towards mid on.

FOUR! Cracker from Cook! Jadeja drops it short and just outside off. Cook pounces on it and punches it through the point area. The timing and placement is too good for the fielders to cut that one out from crossing the ropes.
Flatter and straighter again, blocked out off the back foot.
Fuller on the off stump, worked to mid-wicket.
Too wide of off, left alone.

FOUR Byes. Watta Ball! Shami lands this on just a bit short of a good length around off. Ali, from within his crease, tries to push at the ball. It hits the deck and comes in prodigiously cutting Ali in half and beats his inside edge. The ball keeps moving even after passing the batsman. Pant dives to his right but cannot even get a glove on it. Four byes for the hosts.
Length on off, Keep out off the front foot.
Loose shot from Ali. Loss in concentration may be. Shami lands this one on a length but quite wide of off, Ali throws his hand at it but luckily misses the ball. Ali surviving on the edge of a knife.

Beaten! Ripper. Shami, from around the stumps, fires this in to Ali and lands it on a length on off. The ball pitches and straightens just that wee bit to beat the outside edge of Ali's bat. Luck ridding with the home team.
Keeps it a bit shorter of a good length but outside off which allows Ali to shoulders arms.
Similar delivery and a similar shot by Cook pushing the ball into the mid-wicket region.
Fuller again on the stumps, worked away into the on side by Cook.
Fuller on the stumps, kept out off the front foot.
Quicker and a bit outside off from Jaddu. Cooks tries to cut it but gets beaten for Pant to collect it. That was the skidder and Cook got beaten in pace there.
Full around off, Ali leans forward, drives a bit wide of mid on and run through to complete a single.
Starts off after the break with a shortish delivery on the stumps. Worked into the mid-wicket region.
Drinks! So, an hour after the Lunch hasn't changed things much in terms of the scoreline, however, the continuous change in the conditions overhead has made it a bit frisky for the home team.
Hangs back to keep this one out to the off side for nothing. Cook would have a sigh of relief now.

And again! What an over this has been. Cook could have easily edged all three but he somehow managed to miss all. Another shortish ball around off, Cook stays put in his crease and does not move his feet. Some away swing is there and that means, the ball goes so agonizingly close past the outside edge. A nervy moment for the English highest run-getter in Tests.

Almost the similar ball to the one bowled two balls earlier. Cook again looks to force the matter from his crease and once again, it goes past the outside off. Shami is testing out the opener before the drinks break.
outside off, left alone.
Close, so close this. A back of a length ball outside off and asking Cook to reach for it who does exactly that. It goes past the outside edge and into the mitts of the keeper.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out to the off side for no run.
Ali looks to play the sweep but Jadeja's pace isn't easy to tackle. He gets an inside edge onto his pad but no harm done.
Quicker one on the pads, worked to the on side for a quick single off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Again fast and attacking the stumps. Cook keeps it out off the front foot.
Similar ball in line of the stumps. Cook defends.
Pushes this one on the pads and Cook works it to the on side for nothing.
A boundary saved there by Pant. A quick length ball angled across Ali but it is wide down the leg side. Pant scampers and dives to his right and manages to save a boundary for his team.
Ali defends it from within the crease.
Again wide of off, Cook has nothing to do with it. Some problem for Pant behind the sticks as the ball wobbles and dips just before reaching him.
Wide of off, left alone.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out off the front foot.
Angles this length ball on the pads and Ali flicks it through the square leg region for a couple.
Pushes this one down the ground to keep the strike for the next over. Jadeja finishes his over in a blink of an eye. Too quick!
Pushed through by Jaddu on middle and leg, Cook rocks back and punches it through the on side for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A touch slower around off, Cook gets forward to defend it.
Shortish around off, Cook hangs back and keeps it out.
Fast and full, Cook blocks it out.
Spin time! Jadeja is on now. Bumrah gets a break.
FOUR! Crisply times the full ball down the ground. Ali presents the full face and the connection is sweet. A boundary to end the over.
Wide outside off, on a length, another easy leave for Ali.
Drags his length back and keeps it outside off. Ali happy to let it pass.
Full around off, Ali gets on the front foot and square drives it through the off side. A brace results.
A bumper second up. Ali ducks under it.
Short of a length around off, Ali gets on his toes and keeps it out to the off side.
First change. Shami is on.
Wide outside off stump, Cook leaves it alone.

Prodigious movement through the air and off the deck as well. Bumrah is in nice rhythm here. It lands around off and swings in sharply. Ali looks to flick but misses and gets hit on his thigh pad. A leg bye stolen through the fine leg region.
Outside off, left alone.
The ball is down the leg side but Moeen still goes after it.
Shortish around off, nicely kept out by Ali.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle and off, blocked.
FOUR! Full, outside off and asking for trouble. Cook brings the exquisite cover drive out and gets the desired connection. Pujara runs after it but fails to keep it in.
Hangs in his crease and gets his bat behind the line to defend it.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Cook.
Around off, kept out off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
High! Gets hit on the pads again but luckily for Ali, it is high. No harm done.
Similar length and line, Ali flicks it to the on side this time and gets a brace.
Flicks this one off his pads to the fine leg region for a run.
143 kph! That was quick and in line of the stumps. Cook does well to get behind this one and keep it away from his pad and stumps.
Another solid leave on to the ground.
In line of the stumps, tucked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Outside off, another easy leave.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On the pads, flicked to the on side for a run.
Around off, left alone again.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Around off, defended.

A half appeal this. The overcast conditions and the tight line and length from Bumrah has made life difficult, especially for Ali. He bowls another angled in delivery on a length and Ali fails to connect yet again. The ball hit him high on his pad and that was the reason the umpire declined it once again.
Gets behind the line of this one and defends it.

FOUR! This is salt on the wound. Another beautiful ball on middle and off and going away. Ali looks to defend and gets a thick outside edge. The ball races through the slip cordon and gully region. A boundary results.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
DRS time! Bumrah has urged his skipper to take the review and he has gone with him. Moeen Ali is the man in question. The height though looks to be the issue.

Not Out! And height it is what saved him again. Bumrah is asking questions and a lot of them. He lets it rip around off on a length. The ball goes in with the angle as Ali leaves it and gets hit on the top of his right leg. The visitors appeal but the umpire was never interested in it. Bumrah pleads to his skipper for the review and Kohli does exactly that after a lot of thinking. The replays roll in. The Hawk eye suggests that the ball hit him outside off and as mentioned earlier, it goes over the sticks. Ali hanging on like a leech and India waste a review in rather desperation.
Full around off, pushed to long off for a brace.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
That's the length. This is where Cook is reaching for the balls. It is a tad fuller around off and Cook lunges forward to get a feel of it but misses.
Again in the same channel and another easy leave for Cook.
Angled away from Cook who lets it be.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Down the leg side, Ali looks to flick but fails.
Outside off, left alone.
Ali chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Gets behind the line of this one and defends.

And another. What is happening here? First Rahane and now Kohli. Two of the best fielders in the world have dropped two catches. This time it was Moeen who goes after the outswinger from Bumrah which lands outside off. He hangs his bat in anticipation and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies at the rate of knots to the left of Kohli. He tries to get his left hand behind it cleanly but it wasn't to be. These ones just stick to your hands and it didn't this time as he fails to latch onto it. In the end, two drops in 4 balls and both Moeen and Cook survive. India have been too good in the slip cordon so far and they set high standards for themselves.
On a length around off, almost another edge there but misses by a tiny margin.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.

Dropped! I don't believe it. Rahane drops a dolly. Cook gets a reprieve. Sharma produced a gem here. He bowls a length ball on middle and off. It lands and moves away just a touch but enough to create doubts in Cook's mind. He pokes at it from his crease and a thick outside edge is induced. The ball flies low to Rahane standing in the gully region. It went in and out in a flash. I still don't believe it. One of the best fielders in the world has given a chance to Cook in his last Test. Will he make them pay?
On a length, outside off, left alone.
Away swinger around off from Sharma. Cook plays it to the off side off the back foot.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out.
Around off, left alone.

Peach! An absolute peach this. Bumrah keeps it around off and swings it away once again. Ali looks to play the line but misses by a margin. Some excitement in the Indian camp as the overcast conditions could come to assist them here.

Geez! Squares him up there. Almost a wicket. Bumrah pushes it into the stumps from over the wicket and then takes it away from Ali. He looks to have a tentative poke at it from his crease but only manages a thick outside edge. The ball rolls towards Jadeja at backward point. In the end, no harm done.
Outside off, left alone.
It's chilly here in London. The umpires have called for extra protection from the cold winds.
Closer to the off pole, defended.
Ali lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Too full outside off. Moeen looks to squeeze it out from his crease but fails. Pant collects and appeals but the umpire ignores him and rightly so. There was day-light between bat and ball there.
Bumrah to share the attack.
A watchful start from Cook. He doesn't fiddle with the deliveries angled away from him. A maiden to start with.
A touch fuller and wide of off, left alone.
Swings this length ball away from Cook from the leg stump. A solid defense by the English legend.
Similar to the first ball this. Cook again leaves it for the keeper.
On off on a similar length. Cook blocks it.
Starts the session with a length ball angling across Cook who lets it be.
The post Lunch session is about to get underway. The players are out in the middle from both the sides. Cook will be on strike and Ishant will start the proceedings. Off we go...
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

They grinded it out and added 50 runs for the first wicket. However, the introduction of Jadeja brought India back into the game. He struck and made an impact straightaway on his return. Bumrah too has now found his length and is also getting the ball to talk. They have kept it tight till now but would look for more wickets after the break. The hosts, on the other hand, would want Cook to continue in the same manner and build a solid stand with Moeen Ali.

So, England will be the happier of the two sides heading into the break but India won't be too disappointed. The home side's openers started steadily, leaving balls, defending off a straight bat.
